snippet.title: SILVARN - DEMO Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
SILVARN is coming soon to Steam.
Add it to your Wishlist now.

https://www.etnabytegames.com/
___________________________________
Your family’s cry for help pulls you into a nightmare where every moment counts. A relentless killer forces you to keep moving as you search for answers. Collect clues, solve disturbing puzzles, and uncover the terrifying truth hiding behind the fear.
